{
  "name": "arrester",
  "version": "1.1.3",
  "description": "After a hook, deny rule, or auto mode blocks a tool call, Arrester stops later calls that reach the same result another way or read or change your guards. After your No, it stops only exact retries.",
  "author": {
    "name": "dot-agi"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "homepage": "https://github.com/dot-agi/arrester",
  "repository": "https://github.com/dot-agi/arrester",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/dot-agi/arrester/issues",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/dot-agi/arrester/blob/main/docs/usage.md",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://github.com/dot-agi/arrester#privacy",
  "icon": "./docs/images/icon.png",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "claude-code",
    "security",
    "guardrails",
    "hooks"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "response": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Response to a suspected workaround",
      "description": "deny refuses the call at once with a reason Claude reads. hold asks you in a dialog and waits for your answer; a claude -p run has no one to ask, so the call is refused.",
      "options": [
        "deny",
        "hold"
      ],
      "default": "deny"
    },
    "block_minutes": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Minutes a block stays open",
      "description": "How long Arrester watches after a guard blocks a call, counted from the block or from its last target or retry match. A guard or opaque match alone does not extend it.",
      "default": 30,
      "min": 1,
      "max": 1440
    }
  }
}
